verdict.rationale: Evidence shows scoped, time-limited payment tokens (SPTs) that agents can revoke at any time and that expire per usage_limits, plus one-time-use Link CLI credentials and catalog 'replace mode' deletion for sellers — these are lifecycle/expiration controls rather than a general user-facing data retention/deletion capability. Missing for 10: no documented way for an AI-native end-user to view, export, or delete their broader account/transaction/financial data, no retention policy documentation, and no evidence of a data-deletion API or dashboard control beyond payment-credential revocation.
